name: Rocky Mountain pond-lily
desc: Rocky Mountain pond-lily (Nuphar polysepala): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 21 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Nuphar polysepala, also known as the great yellow pond-lily, wokas, or wocus, is a perennial, rhizomatous, aquatic herb in the genus Nuphar. It has floating green leaves and yellow flowers.
